Name: Make Gil Real
Author: WerewolfMaster
Description:
[center]﻿If you like my work, please consider [url=https://ko-fi.com/quantumleek]buying me a coffee[/url]﻿.
﻿If you like my writing and you read books, why not [url=https://emeryardenbooks.com/]check out mine[/url]﻿?[/center]

Transforms Gil into a real resident of Stardew Valley. He walks! He talks! He... sp..spits in your face because he's a nice guy like that.

DISCLAIMER: Gil says "hell" and "damn" quite a bit. If this bothers you, don't install the mod.

[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]Full schedule and daily dialogue based on heart level.[/*]
[*]2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 heart events[/*]
[*]Unique Marriage dialogue.[/*]
[*]Spouse Room for Gil.[/*]
[*]Gil attends all festivals (after 8 hearts) and can be danced with[/*]
[/list]
[b]Future Plans:[/b]
[list]
[*]14 heart event for Gil[/*]
[*]Spouse patio for Gil[/*]
[/list]
[b]Config Options:[/b]
[list=1]
[*]call_me_kid: (Options: true, false) Option to stop Gil from calling you "kid" (set to false and he won't call you kid). Defaults to true.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Installation:
[/b]Unzip and copy both "[CP] Make Gil Real" and "Make Gil Real" folders into your mod folder
Make sure you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7018]Make Marlon Real [/url]﻿installed
For best results, install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6358]Custom Fixed Dialogue[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7089]Custom NPC Exclusions
[/url]Play!

[*]Stardew Valley Expanded: [b][color=#ff0000]not compatible[/color][/b] (and I'm not planning on making it compatible, please don't ask)﻿[/*]

[center][size=6][b][u]Gil Guide[/u][/b][/size][/center]
Note: Gil is intentionally [b]very difficult [/b]to make friends with. The best way to gain friendship points with him is to gain them with Marlon (as Gil will get a friendship boost each time you see one of Marlon's heart events). He will dislike/hate [b]almost everything [/b]until after you've hit eight hearts with him. Additionally, his pre-8-heart schedule is 95% animated, so you'll only get half points from talking to him (unless you happen to catch him on his way to or from the Adventure Guild). I've also removed him from all job board quests, and he doesn't attend the Feast of the Winter Star. All of this is intentional! Gil actively [i]does not want [/i]to be made friends with. But he'll eventually soften to you if Marlon likes you.

(extra spoiler-y spoiler Re: optional event)
[spoiler]
Gil will be super pissed at you and you'll lose a lot of friendship points.[/spoiler]

6 Hearts
[spoiler]
Enter the town (any time of day). You must have already seen Gil's 4 heart event and Marlon's 6 heart event.[/spoiler]

8 Hearts
[spoiler]
Triggers automatically on the farm the next day. You must have already seen Gil's 6 heart event.[/spoiler]

10 Hearts
[spoiler]
After receiving a note from Gil, go to the Mines between 2pm and 4pm[/spoiler]

[b]Conversation Guide:
[/b]After 4 Heart Event
[spoiler]
After the 4 heart event, you'll get a series of dialogue choices (a new one for each day of the week) where you can either express concern about him or pretend everything is normal and okay. If you express concern, you'll get an extra 10 friendship points per answer.[/spoiler]

After 8 Heart Event
[spoiler]
After the 8 heart event, you'll have the option to hear some long-winded musings from Gil. If you choose not to listen, the option to see these dialogues will [i]not show up again [/i]and you'll jump straight to his default post-8-heart dialogue.[/spoiler]
